design_timing: Module selection and analysis rules fixed before calculating module overlaps for this comparison; earlier broad drug rankings and literature nominations were already known.

modules.label: DNA damage and telomere stress senescence

mask_rule: Remove the union of exact symbols in the Reactome Cell Cycle root and all descendants from signatures, tested sets, and observed backgrounds. Remove each perturbed gene from its own signature and background in both views.
background: Union of genes present in any paired signed signature in the same source/cell/time/perturbation-method stratum. This is an observed library background, not a complete measured-gene list.
directional_score: 100 * (up module hits / retained up-list size - down module hits / retained down-list size), in percentage points of gene-list membership. Unlisted genes are not measured unchanged genes.
aggregation: Median across signature contexts for each perturbed gene within each cell stratum; equal weight per gene in null references and per cell in cross-cell summaries. Keep LINCS and CM4AI separate.
benchmark_test: Two-sided empirical rank: min(1, 2 * min((1 + count(reference >= query))/(n+1), (1 + count(reference <= query))/(n+1))). Inclusive ties. Reference genes exclude BUB1B. These are heterogeneous perturbation benchmarks, not randomized controls or efficacy tests.
batch_sensitivity: Also benchmark each LINCS query context against other perturbed genes in the same cell/time/method/XPR batch. Retain too-small reference groups as unassessable.
enrichment: Separate up/down one-sided hypergeometric overrepresentation tests for every BUB1B signature, module and view; report genes and background coverage.
multiple_testing: BH over all eligible context hypergeometric tests as one family; all eligible cell-level empirical benchmark tests as a second family; all eligible batch-matched empirical tests as a third family. Include both views and all selected modules in each family.
cross_cell_summary: Report all cell scores, direction counts, significant benchmark counts and leave-one-cell-out medians. An exploratory convergence flag requires >=2/3 of cells in one direction and >=2 cells with that direction and empirical all-other-genes q<=0.05. Keep cell-cycle-benchmark support and hiPSC concordance separate. This flag does not determine nomination eligibility.
interpretation: Pathway membership shifts do not directly measure protein stress, mitochondrial respiration or senescence. Removing annotated cell-cycle genes does not regress out all proliferation, viability or cell-state effects.
niacin_policy: Evaluate the NAD+/SIRT2/BUBR1 protein-stabilization chain separately from transcriptional enrichment. Do not turn missing or unfavorable expression reversal into a veto of this mechanism.
